Certainly! Here's a draft of your professional follow-up email:

---

Subject: Request for Pricing Explanation - [Vendor Company Name]

Dear [Vendor Contact Person],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to request an explanation for the pending pricing documents that were due last month. Despite multiple reminders, I have not received them yet.

Could you please provide a brief update on when these documents will be available? Any assistance in understanding any delays would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Company Name]  
[Tel: [Your Phone Number]]  
[Email: [Your Email Address]]

---

Feel free to adjust the details as needed.
